source.title: Cuisses of the Lucent Battalion: original indexed Wowhead Looter disenchant row 1/3
source.author: Wowhead Looter (anonymous pooled submissions)

notes: Original item-side cumulative Wowhead Looter table, epic plate legs. Its 68 source-reported disenchants belong to ONE original item cohort across 3 output rows, not three separate studies. Output row 1/3 lists Refulgent Crystal but extracted page omits item-quality rank and output ID; never assign rank based on display ordering. Source counts material occurrences, not quantities; no measured zero-outcome buckets or stack histograms. Sample epoch, exact original gear variant/bonuses, enchant skill/spec, refund, and live Retail eligibility unknown. Page's PTR display version is not source collection build. WoWDB PTR #61476 separately says this item cannot be disenchanted; build/variant conflict unresolved. Reference-only; not controlled current-patch baseline.
